en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Yahya b. `Imran al-Ash`ari narrated to us. He said: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from Muhammad b. `Umar from Musa b. Ibrahim from Abi'l Hasan Musa b. Ja`far from his father from his grandfather (as). He said:

Umm Salama (ra) said to the Messenger of Allah (s): May my mother and my father be your sacrifice! If a woman married two different men in her life, and they both died, and they went to Paradise, which of the two will she be with? So, he (s) said: O Umm Salama! She will choose the one who had more beautiful character and was better to his family. O Umm Salama! Surely, beautiful character will achieve the good of this world and the Hereafter.
